formation.note: Year the experiment was proposed, used as an approximate formation date; the collaboration's founding is not dated in the sources fetched.
formation.quote: FINUDA (FIsica NUcleare a DAΦNE) (6) in 1993 for the study of hypernuclear spectroscopy

intervals.label: proposal
intervals.note: Year of the proposal. The sources fetched give no approval, construction or installation dates (a 1997 talk expected FINUDA to be operational by the beginning of 1998, arXiv:hep-ex/9712026). The interval ends at the start of the first data taking.
intervals.quote: FINUDA (FIsica NUcleare a DAΦNE) (6) in 1993 for the study of hypernuclear spectroscopy

intervals.label: DAΦNE data taking (two runs)
intervals.locator: FINUDA first-results paper (Phys. Lett. B 622, 2005), Introduction; end = end of the second data taking (arXiv:1011.2695)
intervals.note: Start from the collaboration's own paper (December 2003); Franzini & Moulson date the first physics run November 2003 to March 2004. End = end of the second run (June 2007). FINUDA did not run between the two runs: DAΦNE was dedicated to KLOE from May 2004 to December 2005 (Franzini & Moulson).
intervals.quote: The first FINUDA data taking at DAΦNE started in December 2003 and was successfully concluded in March 2004.

intervals.label: data taking ended
intervals.locator: Milardi (2008), abstract; start = end of the second data taking
intervals.note: The start is the end of the second run (June 2007); the March 2008 accelerator report only says the runs were 'recently completed'. The same report notes the second interaction region was rebuilt to be ready for a possible future FINUDA run; no later run is recorded in the sources fetched.
intervals.quote: has recently completed experimental runs for the three main detectors, KLOE, FINUDA and DEAR

intervals.label: first data taking
intervals.locator: FINUDA first-results paper (Phys. Lett. B 622, 2005), Introduction
intervals.note: Franzini & Moulson: 250 pb^-1 delivered, of which 50 pb^-1 were used for machine studies and detector calibration and 200 pb^-1 for analysis.
intervals.quote: The first FINUDA data taking at DAΦNE started in December 2003 and was successfully concluded in March 2004.

intervals.label: second data taking
intervals.note: 966 pb^-1 recorded (arXiv:1011.2695). The DAΦNE accelerator report gives April 2006 for the start of the second run (arXiv:0803.1450) and Franzini & Moulson expected it 'during summer 2006'; the collaboration's own dates are used.
intervals.quote: accumulated in the second data taking lasted from November 2006 to June 2007

summary.plain: The international collaboration, drawn from Italian, Japanese, Canadian, Korean, Russian and Iranian institutes, that built and ran the FINUDA hypernuclear spectrometer at Frascati's DAΦNE.
summary.technical: FINUDA Collaboration: 54 authors on the 2009 mesonic-decay paper (arXiv listing), with affiliations at INFN sections (Torino, Trieste, Bari, Pavia, Bologna), Frascati, Brescia, ENEA, Victoria, Seoul National University, Tokyo, KEK, RIKEN, TRIUMF, JINR Dubna and Shahid Beheshti University in the first-results paper (2005). Membership list not retrieved.
